title: tasks.yml — the thread's todo list
$comment: A task has no state beyond open or done, and no claims: work that needs either becomes a subthread. The file may be edited by hand. The tool keeps a hash of the file as it last saw it, and on the next command diffs any hand edits into task-added, task-closed, task-edited or task-removed events. A hand-added task without an id gets one then, which is the only time the tool rewrites the file on its own. A promoted task stays on the list with `promoted` set.

id.description: Short id assigned by the tool; absent only on a hand-added task the tool hasn't seen yet.

done.description: The only state a task has. Default false.

promoted.description: Id of the subthread this task became. `view` shows it as a pointer to that thread; the subthread's progress is tracked there, not here.
